attribution.note: Marcus's own words on his Substack. He gives his own assessment of Brockman's remarks rather than quoting someone else's claim.

semantics.note: The draft correctly identifies Marcus's point, keeps the 'sorta kinda' hedge and marks 'rare note of realism' as evaluative. It is a retrospective observation, but a deliberately vague and evaluative one.

contract.note: The contract fairly declines to set binary conditions. Marcus left the degree of acknowledgment open ('sorta kinda') and gave no standard for 'rare realism'. Any threshold would be one he did not supply.

evidence.note: This is the TNW report from 2026-05-01 that Marcus reacted to. Its own wording says Brockman acknowledges the gap, and it quotes him calling the technology 'jagged'. That shows what Marcus was reacting to, but it cannot settle a degree of acknowledgment that Marcus left vague.

reviews.rationale: This is a hedged, evaluative description of Brockman's remarks. 'Sorta kinda' leaves the degree of acknowledgment open, and 'rare note of realism' has no standard to measure against. The TNW report broadly fits Marcus's description but cannot test a threshold he never set. The claim is not broken, only too vague and evaluative to score.
